request.style: Instrumental progressive electronic tactical battle game soundtrack. Propulsive syncopated drum groove with crisp snare, active hi-hats and short tom fills, a strong moving synthesizer bass, interlocking electronic sequences, an expressive analog synthesizer lead and restrained distorted-guitar accents. A definite pulse is present immediately; the rhythmic layers grow through the active sections, pull back during the contrasting passage while keeping the bass pulse, and return in a richer layered variation. Urgent, focused and wistful; clear musical phrases and evolving counterpoint, room for game sounds. Purely instrumental. D#m, 94 BPM.
